stanzas.sanskrit:
क्वचिदथ तपनोपरागकाले
पुरि निदधत्कृतवर्मकामसूनू ।
यदुकुलमहिलावृतः सुतीर्थं
समुपगतोऽसि समन्तपञ्चकाख्यम् ॥ ८४-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Once then during the time of Solar eclipse, leaving behind Kritavarma and Anirudhdha in charge of Dwaraka, Krishna went to the holy spot known as Samantapanchaka, along with the Yaadavas and their womenfolk.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kvacidatha tapanoparāgakāle
puri nidadhatkṛtavarmakāmasūnū |
yadukulamahilāvṛtaḥ sutīrthaṃ
samupagato’si samantapañcakākhyam || 84-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
बहुतरजनताहिताय तत्र
त्वमपि पुनन् विनिमज्ज्य तीर्थतोयम् ।
द्विजगणपरिमुक्तवित्तराशिः
सममिलथाः कुरुपाण्डवादिमित्रैः ॥ ८४-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna took dip in the holy waters to sanctify it for the benefit of human race and gave gifts and money to Brahmins. Krishna interacted with Pandavas and Kauravas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bahutarajanatāhitāya tatra
tvamapi punan vinimajjya tīrthatoyam |
dvijagaṇaparimuktavittarāśiḥ
samamilathāḥ kurupāṇḍavādimitraiḥ || 84-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तव खलु दयिताजनैः समेता
द्रुपदसुता त्वयि गाढभक्तिभारा ।
तदुदितभवदाहृतिप्रकारै-
रतिमुमुदे सममन्यभामिनीभिः ॥ ८४-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Draupadi who was devoted to Krishna spent time with Krishna’s wives.them. She was very much delighted when they narrated the various methods by which they were abducted and married by Krishna. The other women also enjoyed the narrations.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava khalu dayitājanaiḥ sametā
drupadasutā tvayi gāḍhabhaktibhārā |
taduditabhavadāhṛtiprakārai-
ratimumude samamanyabhāminībhiḥ || 84-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु च भगवन् निरीक्ष्य गोपा-
-नतिकुतुकादुपगम्य मानयित्वा ।
चिरतरविरहातुराङ्गरेखाः
पशुपवधूः सरसं त्वमन्वयासीः ॥ ८४-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Seeing the Gopas, Krishna met and honoured them with great joy. The Gopikas who were struck in the sorrow of separation from Bhagwan were excited and Krishna joyfully went to them also.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu ca bhagavan nirīkṣya gopā-
-natikutukādupagamya mānayitvā |
cirataravirahāturāṅgarekhāḥ
paśupavadhūḥ sarasaṃ tvamanvayāsīḥ || 84-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सपदि च भवदीक्षणोत्सवेन
प्रमुषितमानहृदां नितम्बिनीनाम् ।
अतिरसपरिमुक्तकञ्चुलीके
परिचयहृद्यतरे कुचे न्यलैषीः ॥ ८४-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Instantly then, celebrating the joy on seeing Bhagwan, all complaints from the hearts of the beautiful women were wiped away. Krishna made the Gopikas happy as before.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sapadi ca bhavadīkṣaṇotsavena
pramuṣitamānahṛdāṃ nitambinīnām |
atirasaparimuktakañculīke
paricayahṛdyatare kuce nyalaiṣīḥ || 84-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
रिपुजनकलहैः पुनः पुनर्मे
समुपगतैरियती विलम्बनाऽभूत् ।
इति कृतपरिरम्भणे त्वयि द्रा-
-गतिविवशा खलु राधिका निलिल्ये ॥ ८४-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna went to Radha, embraced her and told her that HE could not meet her only because of the continuous attack by the enemies and fight. Radha was overwhelmed and forgot herself in HIS affection.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ripujanakalahaiḥ punaḥ punarme
samupagatairiyatī vilambanā’bhūt |
iti kṛtaparirambhaṇe tvayi drā-
-gativivaśā khalu rādhikā nililye || 84-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अपगतविरहव्यथास्तदा ता
रहसि विधाय ददाथ तत्त्वबोधम् ।
परमसुखचिदात्मकोऽहमात्मे-
-त्युदयतु वः स्फुटमेव चेतसीति ॥ ८४-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: After spending good times with Gopikas and Radha as before,Bhagwan made them realize that HE is the Supreme Bliss Consciousness and the Supreme Brahman, their innermost self.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
apagatavirahavyathāstadā tā
rahasi vidhāya dadātha tattvabodham |
paramasukhacidātmako’hamātme-
-tyudayatu vaḥ sphuṭameva cetasīti || 84-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सुखरसपरिमिश्रितो वियोगः
किमपि पुराऽभवदुद्धवोपदेशैः ।
समभवदमुतः परं तु तासां
परमसुखैक्यमयी भवद्विचिन्ता ॥ ८४-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: There remained a feeling of joy mixed with the sorrow of separation when long back the Gopikas were advised by Uddhava. But after Krishna advised them, they experienced only Supreme bliss at the mere thoughts of HIM.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sukharasaparimiśrito viyogaḥ
kimapi purā’bhavaduddhavopadeśaiḥ |
samabhavadamutaḥ paraṃ tu tāsāṃ
paramasukhaikyamayī bhavadvicintā || 84-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मुनिवरनिवहैस्तवाथ पित्रा
दुरितशमाय शुभानि पृच्छ्यमानैः ।
त्वयि सति किमिदं शुभान्तरैरि-
-त्युरुहसितैरपि याजितस्तदासौ ॥ ८४-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna's father Vasudeva requested the Sages to advise about the good deeds to perform to overcome sins. They laughed and told him when Krishna only is his son, he need not do anything more. Still for his satisfaction, they arranged for a yagna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
munivaranivahaistavātha pitrā
duritaśamāya śubhāni pṛcchyamānaiḥ |
tvayi sati kimidaṃ śubhāntarairi-
-tyuruhasitairapi yājitastadāsau || 84-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सुमहति यजने वितायमाने
प्रमुदितमित्रजने सहैव गोपाः ।
यदुजनमहितास्त्रिमासमात्रं
भवदनुषङ्गरसं पुरेव भेजुः ॥ ८४-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The very big yagna was performed for three months. During that time Krishna friends and the Gopas were honoured by the Yaadavas and they enjoyed Bhagwan company’s pleasure like in the olden days.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sumahati yajane vitāyamāne
pramuditamitrajane sahaiva gopāḥ |
yadujanamahitāstrimāsamātraṃ
bhavadanuṣaṅgarasaṃ pureva bhejuḥ || 84-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
व्यपगमसमये समेत्य राधां दृढमुपगूह्य निरीक्ष्य वीतखेदाम् ।
प्रमुदितहृदय: पुरं प्रयात: पवनपुरेश्वर पाहि मां गदेभ्य: ॥११॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
At the time of departing Bhagwan approached Radha. Krishna were happy to see her free from all sorrow of separation and returned to Dwaraka with a happy heart.
Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan, who removed the miseries of Gopas, Gopikas and Radha, to remove his ailments.
